agreed_point_rule: maximum cardinality; a point inside several rectangles is flagged and stays in n_pred, n_gt, TP, FP, FN
center_in_box_is_not_the_metric: A ground-truth center inside a prediction credits a wide box too easily. It is not a substitute for IoU >= 0.3.

first_eight_base.selection: first eight base ids, chosen before scores, not the owner tech list
first_eight_base.point_rule_used_in_the_first_report: a point counts only when it lies in exactly one rectangle; a point in an intersection was excluded from TP

opened_test_id.why: CountGD boxes were scored and the window overlay was inspected. This id is not an untouched test case. The other test ids were not opened.

countgd_iou_0_3_windows_first_eight.scope: this CountGD text-only CPU configuration on these eight images, not the model family

molmo_saved_points_rescored.both_rules_agree_on_saved_points: None of the saved points lie in more than one rectangle, so maximum cardinality and the exclusive rule give the same TP, FP, FN.

cmp_b0001_window.why_12_and_3: 12 is n_pred. 3 is TP. They are not two launches.
cmp_b0001_window.undecoded_range_in_text: The finished text also contains '30–39' without coordinate tokens. extract_image_points did not turn that range into points. Ids 13–29 are absent from the text. hit_token_cap is false because <|im_end|> is present.

cmp_b0002_window.rerun: only after the token limit changes; not started

molmo_batch.stop_reason: CUDA OOM on the next generate, after cmp_b0002 door was written
molmo_batch.not_restarted: The same 512-token configuration was not continued. cmp_b0003 through cmp_b0008 have no MolmoPoint output.
